Reference image identity: cute translucent icy BLUE CUBE, rounded beveled square body in three-quarter view with visible top and left faces, white snowflake inclusions/frost cracks/bubbles, exactly TWO blue anime eyes with dark thick brows INSIDE their white eye outlines on the front face, small zigzag mouth. NO arms, legs, hands or feet. Omit all detached flying ice shards from reference; game draws projectiles separately. Same polished painted highlights and dark blue outline, pale cyan/royal blue facets. EXACTLY FOUR whole cubes in strict equal TWO rows TWO columns, same camera orientation/scale with full shape inside each cell occupying at most60%cell. Empty transparent padding and broad clear center gutters, real alpha background. No haze, ground shadow, external sparks, particles, text, grid, arrows, extra cubes or props. Genuine individually drawn changes in eye/lid/facet/body poses, not a static drawing resized four times. Four idle poses:1 neutral cube planted with eyes open;2 small brow/cheek expression adjustment with eyes open and interior frosty highlights shifted subtly;3 both eyelids halfway closed, pupils clipped inside eye whites;4 both eyes FULLY shut as dark curved lines, no white/iris/pupil visible, otherwise same planted cube.
